dailyCare.title: DAILY CARE
dailyCare.intro: See what has been recorded. Add something only when it would help.
dailyCare.latest: The latest information currently available in the care record.
dailyCare.noCurrent: No current care updates are available to show. This does not mean nothing happened.
dailyCare.noHistory: No recent care entries are available. No record is not proof that no care took place.
dailyCare.longitudinalIncomplete: This update is saved, but SolenOS could not complete its comparison with earlier care history. The change assessment is incomplete.
dailyCare.openMattersDescription: Questions, missing information and disagreements that have not been marked as resolved.
dailyCare.noOpenMatters: No open matters are currently recorded in this view. This does not confirm that none exist.
dailyCare.sinceLastOpened: Since you last opened Daily Care
dailyCare.sinceLastOpenedDescription: This summary uses records added since your previous visit on this device. It does not describe unrecorded care.
dailyCare.firstVisit: This is the first visit on this device. New recorded updates will appear here the next time you open Daily Care.
dailyCare.selectCount: Select a count to jump to its saved entries in Recent care history below.
dailyCare.noNewRecords: No new care records have been added since your last visit on this device. This does not mean nothing happened.
dailyCare.historyLimit: The summary is based on the latest 200 history records. Open full history to check older entries.
dailyCare.updatesSavedToday: Updates saved today, in time order. No daily entry is required.
dailyCare.medicationChangeNotConfirmed: A medication change was reported, but the new dose has not been confirmed. Check the doctor's instructions or contact the prescribing professional before relying on a different dose.
dailyCare.noUpdatesToday: No updates have been saved today. That does not mean nothing happened, and you do not need to add an entry.
dailyCare.shareSomething: Share something, check in, or leave things as they are. Nothing is required.
dailyCare.chooseShare: Choose what you want to share
dailyCare.somethingDetail: Share an observation in your own words.
dailyCare.medicineDetail: Record what happened with a medicine.
dailyCare.measurementDetail: Record a reading that was actually taken.
dailyCare.photographDetail: Add a photo as care-record evidence.
dailyCare.quickCheckInDetail: Share one overall impression of today.
dailyCare.noteDetail: Save a short note without categorizing it.
dailyCare.historyDescription: Recorded events, in time order. Missing days do not mean nothing happened.
dailyCare.followupsDescription: Open follow-ups stay in their existing record. Daily Care does not create a second copy.
dailyCare.noFollowups: No unresolved follow-ups are currently recorded. This does not confirm that no action is outstanding.
dailyCare.originalFiles: SolenOS keeps the original files and reports what actually happened during processing.
dailyCare.noDocuments: No documents have been uploaded from this account yet.

changeIntelligence.title: Changes and patterns
changeIntelligence.historyMissing: Earlier care information may be missing. That does not mean the event did not happen.
changeIntelligence.disclaimer: These status updates are recorded by the caregiver. They are not medical conclusions.
